title: Best Practices for Handling Delimited Data Imports into Business Central
summary: This post explains how to import comma-separated values (CSV) customer data into Business Central by parsing delimited files into a temporary staging table and then creating customer records. It demonstrates best practices for handling unstructured, flat file formats through code examples and provides a complete workflow from file upload to database insertion.
key_points: CSV is an unstructured flat file format where data is separated by delimiters; columns must be static and consistent across file loads
Use a temporary staging table as an intermediary to import data first, enabling validation, correction, and retry before creating actual records
Parse CSV files using UploadIntoStream to read the file, split text by line breaks, then split each line by the delimiter character
Map parsed values to staging table fields using CopyStr to enforce field length limits, and use Evaluate for type conversion like decimals
Convert validated staging records to actual Business Central records in a separate procedure after successful import
